statics.note: Independent reviewer, round 2: 8/10 (round 1: 7, invented red script on the front box's long side, long supporting line, hook too close to used hooks; image regenerated with plain box sides, copy rewritten). Claims all in Product facts (MOQ 10, delivery within 14 days, Carrot 'Danvers 126', Tomato 'Floradade', ten packets, packed in the USA); no price, no emoji; hook 7 words and new. Image: no added text, no invented words, box sides plain, only kit vegetables; each of the three upright boxes has its black pull tab centred on the bottom short end, no drawer shown. Marked down: at full size '1,000+ SEEDS' and the 'VARIETY MIX' badge text are soft smudges, and the boxes render as flat panels without the raised clay relief of the foundation art. Reservation: wholesale email CTA instead of a standards-table CTA (as on the two earlier wholesale posts).
